mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (name, furigana, nickname, mailaddress, address, tel, age, gender, remark, is_deleted) VALUES (#{name}, #{furigana}, #{nickname}, #{mailaddress}, #{address}, #{tel}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{remark}, #{isDeleted})
INSERT INTO students_courses (student_id, course_name, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET name = #{name}, furigana = #{furigana}, nickname = #{nickname}, mailaddress = #{mailaddress}, address = #{address}, tel = #{tel}, age = #{age}, gender = #{gender}, remark = #{remark}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
